title: The Mary Celeste
youtube_title: A Ship Found Sailing With No One Aboard. 150 Years, No Answer. #shorts #mystery
caption: Food, water, cargo, all untouched. Ten people, gone. The Mary Celeste has never been explained. 🌊 Follow for a new unsolved mystery.
style: dark cinematic digital painting, 19th century, stormy grey ocean light, desaturated, documentary still

scenes.text: In December 1872, sailors spotted a ship drifting in the Atlantic. Nobody was at the wheel.
scenes.image_prompt: a lone 19th century two masted sailing ship drifting on a grey Atlantic sea, torn sails, overcast sky

scenes.text: Her name was the Mary Celeste. The crew of the Dei Gratia rowed over and climbed aboard.
scenes.image_prompt: small wooden rowboat approaching a silent sailing ship across choppy grey water, mist

scenes.text: There was no one there. Not the captain, his wife, their two year old daughter, or the seven crew.
scenes.image_prompt: empty wooden ship deck in fog, coiled ropes, open hatch, no people

scenes.text: There were six months of food and water. The cargo of alcohol was almost untouched.
scenes.image_prompt: dim ship cargo hold full of old wooden barrels lit by a shaft of grey light

scenes.text: The only lifeboat was gone. The last log entry was nine days old, written near the Azores.
scenes.image_prompt: open leather ship logbook on a captain's desk by an oil lamp, a sextant beside it

scenes.text: Theories followed for a century and a half. Pirates. Mutiny. A waterspout. Fumes from the cargo.
scenes.image_prompt: giant waterspout rising from a dark stormy sea beside a distant sailing ship

scenes.text: And the most famous details, the warm tea and half eaten breakfast, never existed.
scenes.image_prompt: a table set with a teacup and plate in an empty ship cabin, ghostly pale light

scenes.text: A young Arthur Conan Doyle invented them in a story. The truth is simpler and stranger. Ten people stepped off a sound ship, and the sea kept the reason.
scenes.image_prompt: tiny empty lifeboat alone on a vast calm grey ocean at dusk, seen from far above
